## Setting
Dividing the utility bills. The five people in a shared house have been splitting gas, water, and electricity in a way that was agreed when only three of them lived there. They are deciding how the bills will be divided from now on. Participants: Ryuji, Rin, Mio, Shunichi and Misaki. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Electrician's quote for the rooms
- The last twelve utility statements
- Monthly settle observed at another house
- Trial run of a reconciliation template
- Kitchen notice about the cooler
- Winter habits at a house paying ahead
- Plug-in monitor readings room by room
- Sunlight and heating need by room
- Payment log for the last twelve months
- Settling up when the last rooms filled

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Mio, Ryuji, Rin, Shunichi and Misaki. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. | Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
| 2 | each participant is told what they found out (that participant only) | 4 turns | nothing |

## Participants
Name: Ryuji
Age: 28
Gender: male
Personality: Ryuji has a calm and cautious personality, and is the type of person who always assesses the situation before acting. He rarely shows his emotions, and spends his time thinking deeply about many things. His friends consider him to be serious and reliable, but his expressionless attitude can sometimes make them feel uneasy. He tends to judge things based on reason rather than intuition, and strongly sticks to his beliefs. He is very independent and often does things at his own pace.
Concern: The utilities envelope has stopped bearing any relation to what I put aside for it, and in the cold months my share lands like a second rent. I do not want to commit to anything before I know what the money actually does across a year, and what changing the setup would cost us up front.

Name: Rin
Age: 9
Gender: female
Personality: Rin is an active and energetic girl. Name: Mio
Age: 17
Gender: female
Personality: Mio has a cheerful and energetic personality that naturally makes those around her smile. She is curious and loves to try new things. Concern: I have started doing arithmetic in my head before switching anything on, and last winter I sat here in a coat rather than be the one who turned the heating up. Name: Shunichi
Age: 32
Gender: male
Personality: Shunichi is a very confident person who can remain calm in any situation. He is not modest, and has a slightly sarcastic side, but that is part of his charm. He rarely becomes overly emotional and can analyze situations calmly and act accordingly, so he has an unexpectedly rational side.
Concern: The way we divide this was worked out when the house was two-thirds full, and it now asks exactly the same of people whose days here look nothing alike. I keep hearing that somebody is carrying somebody else, and I would rather establish whether that is true than let it fester as a rumour.

Name: Misaki
Age: 24
Gender: female
Personality: Misaki has a calm personality and tends to deal with things in a cool-headed manner. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is actually very kind at heart and does not hesitate to lend a helping hand to those in need. - B: Per-Room Metering. Individual meters are fitted to the private rooms, and each person settles their own reading while the shared-area consumption is billed to the household as a whole.
- C: Flat Household Share. The total is divided by the number of residents each month, with the amount recalculated whenever someone moves in or out of the house.

- Electrician's quote for the rooms: An electrician came to look and quoted 34,000 yen a room to fit sub-meters, plus a 3,000 yen check on each every year and two days of wiring.

- Sunlight and heating need by room: Two of the five rooms take no direct sun and need heat from November, while the south pair stay warm into December; the rooms were originally handed out by lot.
- Payment log for the last twelve months: The house's payment log shows three of the last twelve months settled more than a fortnight late, each time after somebody queried why the amount asked of them had moved again.
- Settling up when the last rooms filled: When the last two rooms filled up mid-month, it took three weeks to agree what the newcomers owed for the days before they arrived, and part was written off.
